property_summary: Rule: Only the contract owner can withdraw the contract balance (withdrawAll/withdraw) after any sendMoney call; the mutant inverts the onlyOwner check so a non-owner can withdraw, violating this property for some inputs (i.e., when sendMoney is invoked by the owner and then a non-owner attempts withdrawal).
change_summary: Replaced require(msg.sender == owner) with require(msg.sender != owner) so only non-owner can call withdrawAll.
